ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High white-to-black ratio (approx. 70:30); high-intensity central region bounded by low-intensity margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white interior lobes; continuous low-intensity black perimeter along trailing edge and distal tips; multiple low-intensity vertical linear clusters on right mid-lobe; single isolated low-intensity circular spot on left mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 40-45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edge; significantly increased pixel-amplitude irregularity and raggedness localized at the extreme lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature (upward sweep) originating from the median notch transitioning to an upward-curving distal edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single high-contrast circular pixel cluster located in the mid-region of the left lobe; multiple smaller high-contrast clusters aggregated near the inner trailing edge and midline of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, roughly parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe, extending from the trailing edge towards the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface; irregular material loss and jagged contours at the distal tips of both lobes.
